name: kiki-phone
description: Prepare, preview and operate Android or iOS phones with live workspace screen streaming, Mobilewright semantic scripts, snapshots and screenshots, plus the complete Mobile MCP toolset and optional Android su commands.
author: Kiki

interface.shortDescription: Live Android & iOS screen preview and semantic phone control

zh-CN.shortDescription: Android 与 iOS 实时屏幕预览及语义操控

systemPrompt: Use the phone-control skill for phone tasks. Prefer phone_run with Mobilewright device/screen semantic locators, snapshot() and screenshot(); prepare the runtime only when needed. Preserve observed text, type, id, label and value; refresh after actions before deciding success or repeating input. For advanced Mobile MCP operations, use phone_help for one exact schema, then phone_call with the original mobile_* name and arguments. android_connection and android_shell handle Android connection/root tasks. Remote/cloud allocation requires an explicit user request and any applicable cost authorization.

adbPath.title: Existing ADB executable
adbPath.description: Optional official adb path. Run phone_prepare after changing it to apply one shared ADB to all phone tools.

tools.name: phone_prepare
tools.description: Prepare the phone runtime and report the actual device state. Reuse the selected ADB across phone tools and install upstream packages privately. If Windows ADB is missing, download=true accepts the linked Google terms and permits its download. Preparation does not connect a phone automatically.

download.description: Consent to download official Google platform-tools if ADB is missing, under the terms at https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools.

platform.description: iOS prepares upstream packages without requiring Android ADB.

tools.name: phone_run
tools.description: Preferred phone interface: run async JavaScript with existing Mobilewright device, screen and expect, plus snapshot(), screenshot() that returns an image to Kiki, Android device.wake()/unlock()/sleep()/screenState(), and screen.typeText(). Use semantic screen.getByText/getByLabel/getByRole locators and their tap/fill/check methods. No script lists online devices. The chosen device persists across calls. If the runtime is missing, use phone_prepare. Scripts execute as trusted local code; observe an unclear modifying outcome before repeating it.

script.description: Async JavaScript body. Example: await device.wake(); console.log(await snapshot()); await screenshot(); Native device/screen/expect are Mobilewright 0.0.67 APIs plus Android power/lock helpers; console output is returned.

device.description: Online upstream device id. Required when multiple devices are online and none has been selected. Reuses the selected device on later calls.

timeoutMs.description: Whole script deadline; completed phone actions are not rolled back on cancellation or timeout.

tools.name: android_connection
tools.description: Manage Android ADB connections, separate from screen control. devices returns raw adb devices -l output including unauthorized/offline states; pair uses the wireless pairing address and code; connect/disconnect use the connection address. Pairing and connection ports differ. Requires official Android platform-tools. Does not restart ADB.

address.description: IP:port or host:port. Required for pair, connect and disconnect. Use the pairing port for pair and the debugging port for connect.

code.description: Wireless debugging pairing code; required only for pair.

tools.name: android_shell
tools.description: Run one explicit Android shell command through official adb, optionally using su for a rooted phone. Pass the adb transport serial (from android_connection devices) and command argv, not a shell program. root=true invokes su -c and may prompt on the phone; it does not run adb root. Use upstream Mobile MCP for UI, text and app operations. Returns actual stdout/stderr/exit status; never retries.

serial.description: Exact adb transport serial from android_connection devices, including IP:port for wireless devices. May differ from the Mobile MCP device id.

items.description: One command argument. Quotes, spaces and Chinese characters are preserved as data.

root.description: Use su only for an explicitly requested privileged operation. Ordinary commands run as adb shell.
